subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: Service With a Smile (Listening & Speaking)
lesson: Oman as a tourist destination; Listening 3.4.1: choosing a course / Vocabulary matching and Listening 3.4.2: training to be a chef
outcomes: Talk about tourism in Oman and careers in it
Listen for details about two training courses
Predict the type of information before you listen

tf.s: Over a million tourists visit Oman every year.
tf.why: Yes, tourism in Oman is big and growing.

tf.s: An events management course teaches planning, designing and organising events.
tf.why: Correct, that is what the course covers.

tf.s: The events management diploma takes four years.
tf.why: The diploma takes two years; the degree takes four.

tf.s: The four-year degree is with a partner institute in Ireland.
tf.why: Yes, it is from the Dublin Institute of Technology.

tf.s: Hassan's chef course lasts three years.
'Day release' means going to the institute one day a week while you keep your job.
tf.why: Yes, you study and work at the same time.

tf.s: Hassan does not need any qualification for the job he wants.
tf.why: He wants a formal qualification for a five-star hotel job.

tf.s: The prospects for chefs in Oman are poor.
tf.why: Prospects are excellent because new hotels and restaurants open all the time.

tf.s: Exhibitions are a kind of event.
tf.why: Yes, like conferences, festivals and sporting events.
